description: This file defines the LinkConnector interface, which extends LinkDecoder. It declares methods related to connection management and data transmission, and includes an anonymous inner class implementing a VOID constant instance.

classes.name: LinkConnector
classes.description: An interface that provides methods for connecting, sending commands, restarting, and error checking in a link communication protocol. Also includes a default VOID implementation instance.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Establishes a connection, accepting a listener to monitor connection state.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Sends a command string over the connection, with an option to fire an event; may throw InterruptedException.

methods.name: hasError
methods.description: Checks if the connection has encountered an error.

methods.name: unpack
methods.description: Default method in VOID implementation that unpacks a received packet using the Text Protocol Decoder.
